settings.aboutBio: Independent creative developer focused on crafting fluid interactive WebGL experiences, generative motion design, and high-performance digital typography. Specializing in Three.js, custom GLSL shader pipelines, virtual inertial physics, and cinematic UI choreographies for international brands and design ateliers.

projects.title: Aura Sanctum
projects.description: Spatial architectural visualization, dynamic perspective lighting, and kinetic identity systems for contemporary museum installations.

projects.title: Monolith Void
projects.description: Monochromatic exploration of light, brutalist monolithic structures, and real-time volumetric shadow simulations.

projects.title: Elysian Pulse
projects.description: Dynamic typography deformation and audio-reactive procedural textures created for an interactive sound laboratory.

projects.title: Chronos Rift

projects.title: Silent Form
projects.description: Curated digital sculptures and virtual exhibition halls featuring ultra-smooth inertial drag mechanics and cover UV scaling.
